datasheet_identity.title: SS32B THRU SS320B SURFACE MOUNT SCHOTTKY BARRIER RECTIFIER (SMB Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet SS32B-SS320B; SS36B is the 60 V member: VRRM = VDC = 60 V and VRMS = 42 V (p. 1). IF(AV) = 3.0 A and IFSM = 80 A at 8.3 ms half-sine are common ratings.
Table merged cells assign VF maximum 0.70 V at IF = 3.0 A to SS35B-SS36B; IR1 maximum 0.5 mA at VR = VDC, Ta = 25 degC to SS32B-SS36B; CJ typical 300 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz to SS35B-SS320B (p. 2).
Fig.3 SS35B-SS36B forward trace was digitized from the printed linear-voltage/log-current grid; plotted values are recorded in SI amperes.
Fig.1 and Fig.2 are thermal/surge rating curves and were not digitized. Fig.4 is a normalized reverse-characteristics plot and was not used as an absolute-voltage curve.
No reverse recovery time or measured avalanche/breakdown row is published. VRRM is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown voltage, so breakdown fields are null.
